result.summary: Adds an evalscript subcommand to bitcoin-util for executing Bitcoin script fragments and validating transactions directly using the consensus interpreter. It also exposes CastToBool and extracts CheckTapscriptOpSuccess from ExecuteWitnessScript in src/script/interpreter.cpp to support this utility.
result.problem: Developers designing or debugging Bitcoin scripts currently lack a lightweight standalone command-line tool within Bitcoin Core to evaluate arbitrary script fragments against consensus rules.

result.card: Adds an evalscript subcommand to bitcoin-util to execute script fragments and check signatures directly against consensus interpreter logic. This solves the lack of a standalone offline script execution and debugging tool for Bitcoin script developers. Interpreter changes are limited to exposing helper routines without altering validation rules. The PR is ready for review and has received a tested ACK verifying basic functionality.
